title: Dia Browser tour
description: A scroll-told product tour on cream under a centred serif heading. Desktop: a numbered list pinned at 20% of the window on the left, where the step whose screenshot crosses the middle of the window turns dark, gains a thin black bar and opens its paragraph (the others sit grey and closed), beside a column of large, softly shadowed screenshot frames. Phones: each frame followed by its mono number, serif title and text. Heading and frames fade in on entering view.
notes: needs JavaScript for the active step (an IntersectionObserver): static HTML shows step 1 open
media per item is a placeholder for a screenshot; mediaAspect sets the frame shape (760 / 562 by default)
the pinned list needs the page itself to scroll (no overflow-hidden ancestors)
name: diabrowser-tour
